Posted 'Bossk/IG88/Dengar/Zuckuss in boat' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth, IG-88 In IG-2000, Dengar In Punishing One and Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Jabba's Cruiser' Jabba's Space Cruiser; 'Twilek Adv' Twi'lek Advisor; 'You Can't Hide 4ever' You Cannot Hide Forever; Control is the Dark Premiere Interrupt; Secret Plans and Oppressive Enforcement are the older Effects (not the Reflections III Defensive Shields).

The description names three events (Nashville Grand Slam, Worlds Day 1, DecipherCon Team Tournament); the deck is filed under the 2000 Decipher World Championship, where the hub records his Day 1 disqualification at 3–0. The post signs off 'Steven "Mr DQ" Lewis'.
player_note: The post (17 October 2000) says: 'This is the Court deck I used at the Nashvile Grand Slam, Worlds Day 1, and the Deciphercon Team Tournament. It has never been defeated in tournament play.' (Nashville Grand Slam 19–20 August 2000; DecipherCon 2000, 5–7 October 2000.)
